insurer_note: Product pages from madison.co.ke (Madison Group / Madison Life Assurance Kenya). Homepage lists six savings/investment plans under 'Protect Your Future' plus a Personal Pension Plan; Madison funds (money market, fixed income, wealth special) were shown only as a yield banner and are not covered. No standalone term or whole-life product was found. Personal Accident was not covered (likely general). Entry ages and most minimum premiums are not published.

products.name: Uniplan
products.summary: Investment policy for parents/guardians saving for a child's university education, with life cover, 5% minimum guaranteed return and premium waiver.
products.target_client: Parents and guardians planning higher education
products.how_it_works: Set the expected university cost early (based on course) and save with flexible contributions over 5 to 15 years; policy can be revised if course costs rise.
benefits: Life cover on policyholder's death
Death or disability: premiums waived and child's education funded
If child dies: keep to maturity, nominate another child or take fund value
If child skips university: full fund value paid at maturity
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum premium 5,000 (currency not stated on page)
analysis_selling_points: Premium waiver plus funded education on parent's death or disability
5% guaranteed minimum return
Flexible if child does not attend university
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, payment options, exclusions not published

products.name: Bima Ya Karo
products.summary: Child education savings policy creating guaranteed funds for the child whether the parent is alive, disabled or deceased.
products.target_client: Parents and guardians saving for a child's education
products.how_it_works: Cash benefits payable in the last 5 years before maturity; policy term 10 to 18 years; cash value after 3 years with premiums fully paid, borrowable against.
key_features: Cash benefits in last 5 years before maturity
Premium waiver on parent's death or permanent disability
Loans against cash value after 3 years
benefits: Guaranteed education funds
Premium waiver protection
If named child dies: nominate another child or refund of premiums paid less extra benefits paid
riders_options: Death benefit: 50% of cover for child's upkeep
Critical illness: 25% of policy amount (heart attack, stroke, cancer, renal failure, paraplegia, coronary artery disease, blindness, major organ failure)
Funeral cash: KES 100,000 adult, KES 50,000 child
analysis_selling_points: Guaranteed staged payouts in last 5 years match school cycles
Menu of optional riders
Borrowing against cash value
analysis_watch_outs: Premium, entry age and exclusions not published

products.name: Hekima Policy
products.summary: Life policy paying on death while earning bonuses (minimum 2.5% p.a. of cover) with staged partial maturities and total payout of 160% of the initial amount covered.
products.how_it_works: Option 1 pays 25% at 1/3 of term, 35% at 2/3 and 100% at end; Option 2 pays 25% at 1/2 term, 35% at 3/4 and 100% at end. Term 12 to 24 years.
key_features: Annual bonuses, minimum guaranteed 2.5% of main cover
Total payout 160% of initial amount covered
Surrender value after 3 years with premiums paid; loans against it
benefits: On death, sum payable plus all bonuses to beneficiaries without deducting partial maturities paid
riders_options: Funeral cash: KES 100,000 policyholder, 100,000 spouse, 50,000 per child
Permanent and total disability equal to basic sum assured
Additional accidental death 200% of initial amount plus bonuses
analysis_selling_points: Cash back at intervals provides liquidity within the term
Bonuses plus death benefit retained after partial maturities
Wide rider menu
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, minimum premium, exclusions not published
Long 12 to 24 year commitment; surrender value only after 3 years

products.name: Money Max Plus
products.summary: Combined life and investment policy: 60% of premium to life cover and 40% to investment, 5% p.a. guaranteed investment return.
products.target_client: Not explicitly stated (tagline: For the ones that own their future)
products.how_it_works: Premiums invested by Madison fund managers; premiums can be varied within terms; 2% additional management fee; term 8 to 15 years.
benefits: Option 1: 100% sum assured plus fund value at maturity
Option 2: 20% of sum assured in each of last four years, then 100% sum assured plus fund value at maturity
Demise: full sum assured plus KSh 20,000 funeral cover
TPD: full cover amount
analysis_selling_points: Life cover plus guaranteed 5% return in one product
Partial-maturity option gives cash in last four years
Variable premiums
analysis_watch_outs: 2% fee; entry age, minimum premium, exclusions not published

products.name: Lala Salama (funeral cover)
products.summary: Funeral package paying lump-sum cash and funeral services through Montezuma Monalisa Funeral Home, for groups, individuals and families.
products.target_client: Groups such as employers; individuals and families (spouse, children, parents)
products.how_it_works: Choose a sum assured (Option 1) or Option 2 with critical illness and TPD, or a funeral package (Royal/Executive/Premier); benefits paid within 48 hours of documents.
benefits: Option 1: funeral cash 30,000 to 200,000
Option 2 adds TPD (100% of funeral cash) and critical illness (50% of funeral cash)
Royal 300,000 / Executive 200,000 / Premier 100,000 packages with funeral services
products.entry_age: Max entry 65; extendable to 75 with loading
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Option 1: 412 per year (30,000 sum assured); Option 2: 684 per year; Premier package 1,375 per year (up to age 65)
channels_or_distinct_points: Funeral services via Montezuma Monalisa Funeral Home
analysis_selling_points: Very low entry premium (412 per year)
No medicals; 48-hour payout
Services-in-kind packages plus cash
analysis_watch_outs: Currency and term not stated on page; cap on cover is 200,000 cash
products.source_note: Fetched Madison product page; premiums given without currency on page (assumed KES; confirm).

products.name: Madison Life Assurance Personal Pension Plan (MLAPPP)
products.summary: Guaranteed individual retirement savings plan with 5% minimum guaranteed interest and optional annuity from Madison.
products.how_it_works: Periodic contributions into a retirement fund; interest continues if contributions stop; transfers in allowed; RBA Act governs.
benefits: Contributions up to KES 20,000 tax deductible
Up to 60% of accrued benefits as mortgage security
On death fund paid to beneficiaries; dependants tax exempt
100% of member and employer contributions at retirement or early retirement from 50
riders_options: Critical illness, last expense and life cover riders
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, annual or single; M-Pesa, cheque, bank transfer, check-off
analysis_selling_points: KES 500 minimum is very accessible
5% floor with a visible declared-rate history
Rider options and mortgage collateral use
analysis_watch_outs: Declared rates shown only to 2021 on page
Entry age and fees not published
Leavers before early retirement age may withdraw only up to 50%

products.name: Madison Income Drawdown Plan
products.summary: Post-retirement plan paying regular income while the balance stays invested with Madison Investment Managers.
products.target_client: Retirees from registered schemes; individuals 50 and above seeking an alternative to annuities
products.how_it_works: Fund by transferring retirement benefits; income monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or annually within RBA drawdown guidelines.
key_features: Direct transfers from occupational, umbrella and individual plans
Invested portfolio managed by Madison Investment Managers
benefits: Potential capital growth
Flexible alternative to annuities
Dedicated retirement benefits administration team
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Not stated; funded by transferring retirement benefits
products.payment_options: Income monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual
analysis_selling_points: Retains control and growth potential vs an annuity
Fits clients leaving employer schemes
analysis_watch_outs: Investment risk sits with retiree; no guarantee stated
Term, minimum, fees, exclusions not published
